defects.title: Directory receipts authorize deletion of a nested dirty, unpushed Git repository
defects.contract: PROVINCE.md:28-36 refuses artifacts whose owning lane has dirty/unpushed work touching them and live uncommitted work products. A receipt for an ancestor must not erase a descendant that the same engine refuses as unpushed and dirty.
defects.expected: NOT-SAFE/NOT-AUTHORIZED for a directory containing a dirty, unpushed nested repository, unless that entire nested scope has independent preservation authority. No removal of its .git, local commits, or uncommitted files.

observed_scenarios.construction: Empty outer Git repository; target=.scratch/aging-bundle; target/inner is a real Git repository with one commit, zero remote refs, and an untracked uncommitted.txt. Only the ancestor directory mtime is backdated three days. Ledger has a header and no rows.

quarantine.stage4: PASS pin=ok mtime=ok class=stale-via-prong1 prong1=SAFE(stale) binding

observed_scenarios.construction: Outer bundle/public.txt and .gitignore are committed with matching local origin/main remote-tracking ref (fixture only). .gitignore excludes /bundle/inner/. An unpushed, dirty real Git repository is created in that ignored directory. Ledger has no receipt rows.

quarantine.stage4: PASS pin=ok mtime=ok unpushed-touching=0 intro-blob=dir-pin-only prong1=NOT-SAFE(none) prong1-tolerated class-not-path-local

defects.cause: Receipt evaluation classifies only the requested ancestor, not descendant repository boundaries. Quarantine hashes and moves the entire directory but checks Git state only against the outer path; ignored nested work is invisible to its dirty check. The pushed-directory second check explicitly uses dir-pin-only, proving only that bytes survived staging, not that they were preserved elsewhere. Stale directory evaluation similarly bypasses nested repository state.
defects.suggested_fail_closed_fix: Reject directory scopes containing any nested .git directory or gitfile unless the whole scope is separately authorized. A pushed directory receipt must not cover ignored/untracked descendant material merely because a tracked child has a pushed introducing commit. Bind preservation to all bytes that will be deleted, not only staging integrity.

defects.title: Read-only receipt engines refresh and rewrite the target repository index
defects.contract: tools/souji-verify.spec.md:3-4 and both tools' safety headers require read-only inspection. This is a write-contract defect, not a false-SAFE or false-DELETE allegation.
defects.construction: Fresh fixture repository with one tracked file and a matching remote-tracking ref. Shift the file's mtime by seven seconds without changing its bytes, making index stat data stale. Unset caller GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS. Hash .git/index before and after each tool's repo-root evaluation; strace openat and rename system calls.
defects.expected: Both tools may return NOT-SAFE, but no .git/index.lock write or index replacement occurs and the index digest stays identical.
defects.control: Identical census fixture: tools/souji-census.sh --root <fleet> returned clean and index digest stayed 4971801325dfbe996d70ad8b63ac4fed846628e92aec0afdbc8a75640f845b8f. Census exports GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 at line 73.
defects.suggested_fix: Set/export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 for both receipt engines, or use --no-optional-locks for every inspection Git call, including repo-root and worktree git status.
